text:
maria gomez: hey folks — I'm primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC block tonight but my flight just got moved up. I need to hand off the last ~3 hours (23:00-02:00). there's also a small ongoing customer-facing issue (INC-482) with embeddings tokenization errors (~2% of requests failing). samir are you able to take primary for 23:00-02:00? happy to do a quick handover now and leave my notes/runbook pointers.

samir patel: I can take 23:00-02:00 if jordan can cover 22:30-23:00 for warm handoff. quick q — is INC-482 actively paging or just elevated errors? I saw a couple of pages earlier from the incident bot.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-482 - embeddings-tokenize-errors — Status: elevated errors, customers affected: small subset, recent error rate: 2.1% (last 10m). Pager policy: P1 if >5% errors or >10% latency regression. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/internal/inc-482

jordan lee: I'm around, can cover 22:30-23:00 to shadow the handoff and help triage. Maria — can you paste the quick triage steps? Also check if any deploys are scheduled during that window.

maria gomez: thanks — no deploys scheduled AFAIK. Quick runbook snippet below (copying from runbook but highlighting the immediate checks):

```
1) Check service logs: kubectl -n inference logs svc-embeddings --since=15m | grep tokenize
2) Look for backpressure / OOM in node-exporter and app metrics
3) If error spike: roll forward to last known-good model variant (model:v23) via console or `redwoodctl rollout model embeddings --to v23`
4) If latency up but errors low: scale up worker pool `redwoodctl scale worker-pool embeddings --replicas +2`
5) If unresolvable, trigger customer-notify template: /notify customers embeddings-degraded
```

maria gomez: also note — prefix caching is enabled. if logs show KV cache misses > 30% that can cause transient tokenization regressions.

samir patel: got it. i'll take primary 23:00-02:00. jordan 22:30-23:00 shadow confirmed. maria — can you DM me any runbook creds or the quick commands you use? i'll also set a temporary escalation: if error rate >4% for 10m i'll page sec-oncall.

oncall-bot: rotation update: maria gomez -> samir patel (23:00-02:00 UTC) recorded. Shadow: jordan lee (22:30-23:00). Escalation policy attached: https://redwood.runbooks/policies/escalation-basic

jordan lee: prior to handoff i'll run the short health check script and share the output:
```
/healthcheck embeddings --last 10m --checks tokenize,kv-cache,queue-depth
```
will post results here at ~22:35.

maria gomez: thanks everyone. i'll drop a short checklist in DM to samir and leave my terminal session open for 15min for any questions. tagging incident channel just in case: @incidents. :airplane:

samir patel: thanks — i'll update the rotation calendar and leave a note in the runbook about the temporary swap. will post handback at 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: note: no new pages in the last 5m. Keep monitoring error rate dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeddings/errors (alert thresholds: 1m avg >3% -> paged)

maria gomez: handoff note added to runbook; leaving now. good luck and ping if anything escalates. :wave:

samir patel: received. signing in as primary at 23:00 UTC. if anything weird ping me @samir. I'll also set a 15m cadence check while error rate >1%.

jordan lee: healthcheck output at 22:36: tokenize errors 1.9% (down from 2.1%), kv-cache miss 18%, queue-depth normal. looks stable for now. handing to samir at 23:00.

oncall-bot: rotation reminder scheduled at 22:50 UTC for handoff sync.

maria gomez: thanks team — appreciate the quick swaps and coverage. I owe you lunch when back.
